page.overview:
Who is Talene Minly?

Talene Minly was an Aes Sedai and a Sitter. She belongs to the Black Ajah, posing as a sister of the Green Ajah.

She is described as being statuesque with golden hair. She has blue eyes and is beautiful, with a perfect oval face, full red lips, full-bosomed and round of hip. Seaine thought of her as "beauty carved from ice", though this thought came at a time of tension. Talene could be very personable and charming, though she hated deferring to anyone or to be less than another in any way whatsoever.

Talene has a One Power strength of , which is strong for an Aes Sedai.

While she is strong enough to Travel, there is no way she would have been able to learn the weave.
